gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patient must have histologically confirmed diagnosis of: WHO grade III or IV glioma or glioblastoma or gliosarcoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: Researchers will investigate the ability of Xevinapant to cross the blood-brain barrier and exert anti-tumor effects on rHGG through activation of apoptosis.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Concentration of unbound Xevinapant in brain tumor tissue in an exploratory manner (within contrast enhancing tumor as well as non-enhancing tumor, wherever possible) at the time of planned salvage resection.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: demonstrate pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic effects in HGG tumors

role_evidence.quote: Xevinapant is an investigational medication, taken orally, that promotes cancer cell death via apoptosis.

agents.drug_class_hint: IAP (inhibitor of apoptosis protein) antagonist / SMAC mimetic
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: promotes cancer cell death via apoptosis

coder_notes: Window-of-opportunity PK/PD study before salvage resection. Eligibility is WHO grade III-IV glioma, glioblastoma or gliosarcoma. Exclusion criteria mention chemotherapy only in contraception context; no chemotherapy is registered.
